findings.assessment: The claimed velocity-difference range 0.021386880777076088 to 0.12414427543983646 m/s is not the range of the eight displayed intervals. Their actual minimum and maximum are 0.018534244890083693 and 0.1534294782532689 m/s. The selected values are exact, but the range claim omits other displayed values.

The claim that only 0.30-0.35 s motion was displayed overlooks measured 0.28 and 0.29 s endpoints returned by the prediction query. Scoped queried declarations passing the validator do not validate this broader unread prose.

The reported roughly 0.64-1.48 m/s range excludes the 1.5810152739742807 m/s sample present in handed-over feedback. The description is defensible only as a range of the cited subset, not the whole settling window.
Speed failure is established, but the holding window also fails its position condition. It should not be presented as exclusively a speed failure.

Reach acceptance rules out a recorded reach failure; it does not rule out geometry influencing settling, controller behavior or computational effort. Deferral for insufficient evidence is narrower and supported.
